name: com.stitchpunk.dotsanimationtoolkit
description: DOTS-native animation toolkit for Unity Entities: 2.5D cutout transform tracks, flipbook sprite animation, and bone/vertex animation textures (VAT), with blob-baked clip registries, Burst-compiled sampling, and an editor clip pipeline. Pre-release: version 0.4.0 contains the data and sampling layer, the authoring assets with validation and the deterministic clip-registry builder, and entity baking (build steps C1 to C3). Actors now bake to entities, but no system drives them yet — playback, events, bounds and LOD land in subsequent 0.x versions.

samples.description: Generates a complete working actor - rig, clip set, an animated clip, and a prefab wired to bake - through the same public API you would use yourself.
